import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from engine import project
rng = random.Random(99)
def borders(n, U):
    n = min(n, U)
    cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), n-1)) if n > 1 else []
    return [0] + cuts + [U]
bad = 0
for trial in range(4000):
    U = rng.choice([5, 17, 100])
    old = borders(rng.randint(1, 8), U)
    new = borders(rng.randint(1, 8), U)
    nold = len(old) - 1
    vals = [rng.randint(-5, 40) for _ in range(nold)]
    out = project(old, vals, new, len(new)-1)
    if sum(out) != sum(vals):
        bad += 1; print('total', old, vals, new, out)
    vals2 = [rng.randint(0, 40) for _ in range(nold)]
    out2 = project(old, vals2, new, len(new)-1)
    assert all(x >= 0 for x in out2) and sum(out2) == sum(vals2), (old, vals2, new, out2)
print('projection total-preservation failures:', bad)

def ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v):
    cl = lambda x: max(0, min(x, c-b))
    return (m*cl(v-b))//(c-b) - (m*cl(u-b))//(c-b)
ok = 0
for trial in range(4000):
    U = rng.randint(2, 60)
    b = rng.randint(0, U-1); c = rng.randint(b+1, U)
    u = rng.randint(0, U-1); v = rng.randint(u+1, U)
    m = rng.randint(0, 1000)
    if b > 0:
        old, vals = [0, b, c, U], [0, m, 0]
    else:
        old, vals = [0, c, U], [m, 0]
    if u > 0:
        new = [0, u, v, U]
    else:
        new = [0, v, U]
    out = project(old, vals, new, len(new)-1)
    assert out[1] if u > 0 else out[0], (m,b,c,u,v,out)
    got = out[1] if u > 0 else out[0]
    assert got == ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v), (m, b, c, u, v, got)
    ok += 1
print('literal formula agreement on %d random cases' % ok)
